{#- The accent colour setting as a CSS custom property. Core validates `color` settings (`#rgb` / `#rrggbb`); the template checks again that it is `#` plus 3 or 6 hex digits, so nothing else can reach CSS. -#} {%- set accent = site.settings.accent_color -%} {%- set ns = namespace(ok=accent is string and accent | length in [4, 7] and accent[0] == "#") -%} {%- if ns.ok -%} {%- for c in accent[1:] -%} {%- if c not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" %}{% set ns.ok = false %}{% endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if ns.ok %} {%- endif %}
